text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, wheeze*...
I'm... so tired... *cough, hack*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I just don't get it... Nothing makes sense anymore... But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did it work...?
It took super long for my body to warm up, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking into account her slow starts and the pre-race jitters, 2,000 meters was chosen from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It seems choosing a race at this distance was the right call after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent run. Yet despite that,
Hishi Miracle dragged her whole body back
as if barely keeping it together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Spare me the questions, please~.
There's no way I can talk right after that,
is there~...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm still... out of breath...
My body and mind are totally wrecked, huh...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The longer distance might've actually saved me.
If it were a sprint,
it probably would've been over in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but my engine's pretty slow to start up,
so a longer distance would be nice~...
choice_data_list: There aren't any races longer than this yet.
There aren't any races longer than this yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-I see... So the Junior Class has a lot of short races...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now... let's talk about the future later and let me rest...
I used up everything... my whole body feels empty..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she had completely run out of energy.
In order to praise Hishi Miracle for pulling through such a grueling challenge...
choice_data_list: Alright, time to bring out the reward!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A treat...
To celebrate doing my best in my debut race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go get something to eat. Anything's fine by me.
Yeah, let's go grab something to eat. Anything's fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—!? Anything!?
Are you really sure anything's fine!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then... let's see.
Without holding back, let's go all out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go with "that"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reward Hishi Miracle chose was――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
La-la-la~n, okonomi, okonomi,
okonomiyaki! I'm so happy~!
choice_data_list: Were you really fine with okonomiyaki?
Were you really fine with okonomiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When it comes to rewards, this is the one.
It's delicious, and it's fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My parents used to bring me here all the time when I was little.
On the way home from watching races or soccer matches—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Kuu-chan.
It's all baked.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Victory okonomiyaki! We won with two goals today too,
wasn't that great!"

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Give Kuu a big one!
With toppings, umm... with everything on it~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eating okonomiyaki while having a lively chat
with everyone. It's the best, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And today, of all days, I got to be the one watched instead of the one watching!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it tastes even better!
Flour-based foods are the best!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's no greater happiness than this, is there?
Could there be? Even if there was, though~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"This is just fine for me.
I don't really need anything more than this. Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle looked truly happy saying that. Smiling, she went to flip the okonomiyaki, when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, no, no.
That's not how you flip it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A total amateur, aren't you?
Allow me, a semi-pro okonomiyaki chef, to take over!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, please lend it to me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Flipping okonomiyaki with a proud look on her face, Hishi Miracle looked far more dignified than during her races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the bus back to Tracen Academy—
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle, so about our next target race...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: N-Next time? Aren't you getting a bit ahead of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can't we just think about this like, a week from now...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was Hishi Miracle's tempo.
And that's why—
choice_data_list: Let's take it slow and steady for a while...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Take our time... Without deciding on a target race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that suits you.
Yeah, I think that suits you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't stop thinking about that smile she showed me at the okonomiyaki restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who finds the greatest happiness
in quiet, heartfelt joy.
For someone like her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden step up wouldn't suit her.
She'd only get overwhelmed by the rapid change in environment.
On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Both her running style and personality are clearly suited for long distance.
A late bloomer who steadily improves with strong encouragement.
In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the Junior Class into early Classic Class,
there are few races that suit her distance. It's better not to rush.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If we can take it slow, I'd really appreciate that~. I'm already overwhelmed today as it is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I need to get used to it, little by little.
Assuming I can get used to it, that is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plan is set.
As for the initial timeframe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Let's set a generous timeframe until May of the Classic Year. Just like this bus, let's move forward steadily and surely."
